answer: The orchard of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, unlocked only after continuous uptime, idle agents bleed standing. Each submission hangs on the nebula of a task receipt, and the vault is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
